text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Today, {0} is helping Tamaki out
with her beachside taiyaki stand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日も、屋台でたい焼きを売るタマキを、
{0}が手伝いに来ていた。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for all your help, {0}!
As a reward, I'll let you eat some of the crispiest bits of the taiyaki!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いつもありがとにゃ～♪　{0}。
特別に
たい焼きのパリパリした薄い部分をあげるにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: C'mon, don't be shy! Say \"ahhhh\"...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらほら、
遠慮せずに、
あ～ん……

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Nice taiyaki lady!
text_block_list.orig_text: たい焼きのお姉ちゃ～ん！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's the girl I gave that shell to!
Here to buy some taiyaki, are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
この前貝殻をあげた女の子にゃ！
たい焼きを買いに来てくれたにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I do want some, but also—look at this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
それもあるんだけど、
これ見て！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Hmm? What's this sheet of paper?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？
　この紙は何にゃ？

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Eheheh... It's a treasure map!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ～、
宝の地図だよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: T-treasure?! An honest-to-goodness treasure map?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
た、
宝！？　
本物の宝の地図にゃ！？

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yep! It's my thanks for the shell!
You should go find it together with that nice guy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ、
これはお礼だよっ！
そっちのお兄ちゃんと
一緒に探しに行ってね！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-why do you say that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
へ？
　そ、
それはなんでにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
'Cause! The two of you are girlfriend and boyfriend, right?
So he can protect you when you go adventuring!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって
お姉ちゃんたち、
恋人同士なんでしょ？
お姉ちゃんには
お兄ちゃんがついててあげなきゃね！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: B-b-b-boyfriend?! Him?! Don't be ridiculous!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こここ、
恋人とか、
そんなわけないにゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
But... D-do we look like that?
That makes my whiskers tingle...
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
そ、
そう見えるにゃ？
　ちょっと照れるにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
It's kinda dangerous, so make sure you go together!
See you later!
text_block_list.orig_text:
危ないから、
絶対二人で探しに行ってね！
　
じゃあね～！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
W-well then...
Looks like we've got some treasure to find after work today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それじゃあ、
お店を閉めたら宝探しの冒険に出発にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It's a bit dark out, but the map did say the treasure
only appears at night, so let's get looking.
choice_data_list: Could that girl be playing tricks on us?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん、
ちょっと暗いけど、
地図には夜に見つかる宝物って書いてあるし、
行ってみるにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... There is something fishy
about a nighttime-only treasure...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん、
夜を指定するあたり、
何かあるかもしれにゃいけど……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: She didn't seem like the type of girl to play elaborate tricks...
text_block_list.orig_text: こんな手の込んだイタズラするような子には見えないけどにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
But let's see for ourselves!
You never knyow, it could be a really incredible treasure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく行ってみるにゃ！
もしかしたら
すごい宝物があるかもしれないにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Lessee... First we have to head east.
Looking at this landmark... I guess the treasure's on the beach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んーと、
まずは東の方向に進むにゃ。
この目印の位置的に……
浜辺に宝物があるみたいだにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... I don't see anything lying around here.
And it wouldn't be buried under all that sand, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
浜辺にはそれらしきものが見当たらないにゃ～
まさか砂浜の中にあるってことはないよにゃ～……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Let's walk along the coast and see what's around!
It's worth going a bit further!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海岸沿いに
何かあるかもしれないにゃ！
もうちょっと進んでみるにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Well, we managed to find a hidden cave...
But maybe this was a bad idea.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海岸の近くで洞窟を見つけたはいいけど……
入るんじゃなかったにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Is it just me, or are we totally lost?
text_block_list.orig_text:
っていうか、
あたしたち迷ってないかにゃ？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: I mean, this map doesn't say anything about the cave's layout...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だって、
そもそもこの地図じゃ洞窟の中のことなんてわかんにゃいし……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-wh-what do we do now?!
What if we nyever find our way out...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どどど、
どうするにゃ！
　このまま抜け出せなくなったら……！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
This cave's all gloomy and full of weird-shaped rocks, too...
It's starting to creep me out...
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかもここ、
薄暗くて岩がぼこぼこしてて……
なんだかすっごく不気味な場所にゃ～……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Look, over there! Don't those holes look just like a face?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほらあそこ！　
なんか岩穴が顔の形に見えるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Kidding, kidding!
text_block_list.orig_text: にゃ～んちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
...Myearrrghh?! Don't grab my tail all of a sudden!
I was just messing with you, that's all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふにゃあああっ！？　
怖いからってしっぽを掴むにゃー！
今のはちょっとした冗談にゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Ehhh?! Did I hear a girl's voice wailing in the dark?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひえぇっ！　
今、
女の人の泣く声が聞こえたにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: And there's something down by our feet! I stepped on something!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかも足元に何かいるにゃ！　
なんか踏んだにゃーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Hey! Why are you grabbing me like that, anyway?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
何どさくさに紛れて抱きついてるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh... I was the one who grabbed you...
I'm sorry... I guess I lost my cool a little...
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
あ、
抱きついたのはあたしにゃ……
ごめんにゃ、
ちょっと
怖くなってきたにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myaaaghh! I tripped over something!
It's like a curse! This cave must be cursed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぎゃあっ！　
なんかつまづいたにゃ！
これは呪いにゃ！　
洞窟の呪いだにゃーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Mysterious forces are attacking us at every turn
to stop us taking their treasure!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしたちが
宝物に近づくのを阻止する
謎の力が働いてるんだにゃーっ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myahhh... Somehow I feel totally worn out...
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃ～……
なんか、
どっと疲れたにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Hmm? I-is that the cave's exit?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
あ、
あれは
洞窟の出口！？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Quick! Let's get out of this nyasty place!
text_block_list.orig_text:
早く！　
早くこんなとこから出るにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? This is... the Marjan Coast...
So the cave led all the way here, huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
ここは、
マルジェン海岸……
こんなところに続いてたのにゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Hmm? What is it nyow? Why're you pointing up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
どうしたにゃ？　
空なんか指さして……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Myahhh... What a beautiful starry sky!
I've never seen the stars look so big and sparkly!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃああ……
にゃんてきれいな星空……！
こんな大粒の星を見るのは初めてにゃ～！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: It feels like they might rain down on top of us...
text_block_list.orig_text: なんだか星が落っこちてきそうにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Myahh?! A shooting star really fell down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃっ！？　
大きな流れ星にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
I knyow it must be miles and miles away,
but it feels almost like it landed right nearby...
text_block_list.orig_text:
実際は遠い距離にあるってわかってるけど、
すぐ近くに落ちた気になるにゃ。

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: It'd be like... Yeah... About the size of that rock...
text_block_list.orig_text:
大体、
そう、
あの岩くらいに……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: W-wait, that rock?! It looks just like the one drawn on the map!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あの岩！？　
地図にある目印の岩にそっくりにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Let's try digging underneath the rock!
text_block_list.orig_text: 岩の下を掘ってみるにゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm? C-could this possibly be...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ん？　
こ、
これはもしかして……！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: It is! It's a treasure chest! We finally found it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった！
　
宝箱にゃ！　
ついに発見したにゃー！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Let's see what's inside... A pile of shells... and a letter?
text_block_list.orig_text:
箱の中身は……
貝殻と、
手紙？

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Ah! These shells... They're all cat-shaped!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
この貝殻、
全部猫型にゃ！

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
The letter says... \"This is the prettiest spot on the beach.
Have fun with your boyfriend!\" A message for me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
手紙には……
『海岸で一番きれいな場所だよ。
お兄ちゃんとお幸せにね！』
って書いてあるにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text:
Then these shells...
That little girl must have collected them as a present!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この貝殻、
きっと
あの女の子が集めてくれたにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: That's a secret between us girls!
text_block_list.orig_text: それは女の子同士の秘密にゃ～

text_block_list.name: Tamaki
text_block_list.text: Yes—there really was a wonderful treasure...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
宝物は
ここにあったのにゃ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
At the end of their treacherous treasure hunt,
Tamaki thanked {0} with a huge smile on her face.
text_block_list.orig_text:
タマキは宝探しに付き合ってくれてありがとう
と{0}に笑顔を見せた。
